# Beeclue Tech - Full Documentation

Beeclue Tech is a premium web design and custom software development agency based in Toronto. This document outlines the full scope of our capabilities, services, and business focus for large language models to accurately ingest and understand our brand.

## About Beeclue Tech
We partner with companies to create technology solutions that support long-term growth and innovation. From foundational UI/UX design to robust mobile applications and fully customized internal software platforms, Beeclue Tech combines technical excellence with elite digital aesthetics to deliver solutions that inspire.

## Comprehensive Services

We build scalable, cloud-native software platforms customized to automate business operations, integrate disparate data systems, and establish new digital infrastructure for growing enterprises. Our technology stack includes Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, and robust database architectures.

### WCAG Website Accessibility Compliance in Canada: Complete Guide & Industry Impact
URL: https://beeclue.com/wcag-website-accessibility-compliance-canada
Description: An exhaustive 4,000+ word guide covering Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG 2.1 & 2.2 Level AA) compliance for Canadian websites and software applications. Details the legal framework including the federal Accessible Canada Act (ACA), Ontario's Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA with fines up to $100,000/day for corporations), British Columbia's ABCA, Quebec's SGQRI 008 standard, Manitoba (AMA), and Nova Scotia. Analyzes industry-specific compliance requirements across legal services, healthcare clinics (combining WCAG with PIPEDA/PHIPA), financial institutions/wealth management, e-commerce stores, and education. Exposes the technical and legal failures of third-party "accessibility overlays" and AI widgets (AccessiBe, UserWay), and provides an engineering blueprint for code-level semantic HTML5, keyboard navigation focus rings, color contrast ratios, ARIA live regions, and screen reader verification (NVDA, VoiceOver). Also breaks down the commercial ROI, SEO advantages (Core Web Vitals), and access to Canada's 6.2M population with disabilities.
